ctaHeading: Craigieburn's shower leak pros are ready to help.
aboutText: With 12 years of experience, Shower Leaking Specialist is Craigieburn's trusted choice for all shower repairs. We provide cost-effective solutions using mould-resistant sealants in various colours to suit your decor. As Melbourne's number one shower repair professionals, we proudly serve local building, plumbing, strata, and real estate firms.
servicesText: We offer expert shower leak detection, sealant application, and bathroom renovations using high-quality materials. Our standard service is more affordable than tiles-removed options, ensuring lasting, mould-free results tailored to your needs.

services.title: Shower Leak Detection
services.desc: We use advanced techniques to pinpoint leaks quickly, preventing water damage and mould growth in your Craigieburn bathroom.

services.title: Sealant Application
services.desc: Our mould-resistant sealants come in various colours to match your tiles and bathroom decor, providing durable protection.

services.title: Tile Replacement
services.desc: We replace damaged or worn tiles with precision, ensuring a seamless finish and long-term durability for your shower.

services.title: Waterproofing Services
services.desc: Comprehensive waterproofing solutions to protect your shower and bathroom from future leaks and water ingress.

services.title: Bathroom Renovations

services.title: Emergency Repairs
